name: exact
expectation: Positive: byte-identical copied function, above threshold.

name: renamed
expectation: Positive type-2: renamed identifiers and numeric literal.

name: near
expectation: Positive type-3: one inserted logging statement; any surviving exact fragments are partial recall.

name: unrelated
expectation: Negative: unrelated numeric accumulation vs sorted string normalization, both above 50 tokens.

name: idiom
expectation: Ambiguous structure, not a refactoring defect label: independent HTTP response vs UI notification data builders.
